notes.purpose: Pilot: transfer-based black-box evaluation, not a full ImageNet BSR reproduction
notes.bsr_sampling: New shared-in-batch transform parameters per view and step; bilinear interpolation, zero fill
notes.normalization: Inside model wrapper, perturbation constrained in raw [0,1] pixels
notes.freeze: Freeze config, IDs, source and weight hashes before test target inference; no target-based tuning
notes.randomness: Seeded sampling; CUDA grid_sample backward can retain nondeterminism
notes.future_target: cifar10_vgg11_bn; not included in this pilot
